headline: Exchanges Shed 308.4 Million Dollars As OKX Outflow Widened To 124.2 Million
narrative: Exchanges shed 308.4 million dollars over 24 hours, 0.1149 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, deepening a 252.0 million dollar outflow at 0.094 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a negative print means money left the place where holders can sell, and OKX shed 124.2 million dollars after a 92.1 million dollar outflow while Binance shed 193.2 million dollars after a 250.3 million dollar outflow. Bitget shed 49.9 million dollars and Bybit shed 22.1 million, while Gate took in 41.4 million dollars.
author: jordan
